claims: Artemis II is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:24 p.m. EDT from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II launch window opens at 6:24 p.m. EDT and lasts until 8:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II launch window is two hours long.
The Artemis II launch window opens at 22:24 GMT.
Artemis II aims to send four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
There is an 80% chance of favorable weather for the Artemis II launch.
The Artemis II launch location is Launch Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Backup launch windows for Artemis II are available through April 6.
Backup launch windows for Artemis II are available on April 30.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch begins at 12:50 p.m. EDT on NASA+, YouTube, and Amazon Prime.
Artemis II is a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
Artemis II features astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen
